methods_quotes.q: Analyses were conducted using SAS software (version 9.4; SAS Institute); p-values <0.05 were considered statistically significant.
VAERS reports were described by serious and nonserious status, demographic characteristics, and MedDRA PTs.
Processed VAERS reports are those that have been coded using MedDRA, deduplicated, and undergone standard quality assurance and quality control review.
